fields.summary_ko.0: Truist raised Walmart (WMT) price target from $114 to $134 while maintaining a Buy rating, offering 6% upside versus current price.
fields.summary_ko.1: Walmart expanded market share in Q3 through competitive pricing and fast shipping, with advertising business, online marketplace, and membership business serving as additional revenue streams.
fields.summary_ko.2: Walmart raised 2027 net revenue growth rate from prior 4–5% to 4.9–5.2%, with U.S. e-commerce sales up 23%, Sam's Club up 30%, and global e-commerce revenue up 17%.
